# openmetadata_data_contract (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata data contract by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_data_contract" "users" {
  fully_qualified_name = "warehouse.analytics.public.users.users-monthly-reporting"
}

output "users_data_contract_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_data_contract.users.id
}

output "users_data_contract_status" {
  value = data.openmetadata_data_contract.users.entity_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Data contract fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Data contract UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `effective_from` (String) Start of the contract's effective period in RFC 3339 format.
- `effective_until` (String) End of the contract's effective period in RFC 3339 format.
- `entity` (String) Fully qualified name of the table governed by the contract.
- `entity_status` (String) Server-computed status of the governed entity.
- `name` (String) Data contract name.
- `terms_of_use` (String) Terms of use content.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
